tasks.subject: Task 1: HelmRepository + HelmRelease Traefik
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Créer les manifests Flux qui déploient Traefik via Helm avec un Service LoadBalancer MetalLB.

**Files:**
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/sources/traefik.yaml`
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator.yaml`
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator/kustomization.yaml`
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator/helmrelease.yaml`
- Modify: `kubernetes/infrastructure/kustomization.yaml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] HelmRepository pointe vers https://traefik.github.io/charts
- [ ] HelmRelease version 34.* targetNamespace traefik-system
- [ ] service.type: LoadBalancer
- [ ] ingressRoute.dashboard.enabled: false
- [ ] dependsOn: metallb-config, wait:true, timeout:5m
- [ ] yamllint passe

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/sources/traefik.yaml kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator.yaml kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator/`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/infrastructure/sources/traefik.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator/kustomization.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator/helmrelease.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/kustomization.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/sources/traefik.yaml kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator.yaml kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-operator/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["HelmRepository pointe vers https://traefik.github.io/charts", "HelmRelease version 34.* targetNamespace traefik-system", "service.type: LoadBalancer", "ingressRoute.dashboard.enabled: false", "dependsOn: metallb-config wait:true timeout:5m", "yamllint passe"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Flux Kustomization traefik-config + IngressRoute dashboard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Exposer le dashboard Traefik sur http://dashboard.homelab.lan/dashboard/ via une IngressRoute CRD.

**Files:**
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config.yaml`
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config/kustomization.yaml`
- Create: `kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config/dashboard.yaml`
- Modify: `kubernetes/infrastructure/kustomization.yaml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] dependsOn: traefik-operator, wait:true, timeout:2m
- [ ] IngressRoute dashboard.homelab.lan vers api@internal
- [ ] yamllint passe

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config.yaml kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config/`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config/kustomization.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config/dashboard.yaml", "kubernetes/infrastructure/kustomization.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config.yaml kubernetes/infrastructure/traefik-config/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dependsOn: traefik-operator wait:true timeout:2m", "IngressRoute dashboard.homelab.lan vers api@internal", "yamllint passe"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Corriger demo.yaml — Service LoadBalancer → ClusterIP
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Le Service demo n'a pas besoin d'une IP MetalLB puisqu'il est exposé via Ingress Traefik ; passer le type à ClusterIP.

**Files:**
- Modify: `kubernetes/apps/demo.yaml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] spec.type: ClusterIP dans le Service demo
- [ ] Ingress inchangé

**Verify:** `grep 'type:' kubernetes/apps/demo.yaml` → retourne `  type: ClusterIP`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/apps/demo.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "grep 'type:' kubernetes/apps/demo.yaml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["spec.type: ClusterIP dans le Service demo", "Ingress inchangé"]}
```
